rubix.system.disk.ok: Disk usage is normal ({percent}% used, {free} free, probed at {at}).
rubix.system.disk.warn: Disk is nearly full ({percent}% used, {free} free, probed at {at}).
rubix.system.disk.full: Disk is full ({percent}% used, {free} free, probed at {at}).
rubix.system.db.ok: Database is reachable ({used} bytes in use, probed at {at}).

rubix.clickhouse.retention.unchanged: Retention for ClickHouse table {table} already {days} days; no change made (at {at}).

rubix.flow.linted: Flow body parses cleanly; no lint errors.

rubix.goal.not_wired: Goal {goal} is not wired yet; see {design_doc} for the unblock criteria.
rubix.analytics.query.unknown_template: Analytics query refused — no template named {name}.

rubix.analytics.report.rendered: Analytics report {template} rendered as {format} ({bytes} bytes, {queries} queries).
rubix.analytics.report.empty: Analytics report {template} rendered with no data ({format}, {queries} queries returned zero rows).
rubix.analytics.report.format_unsupporte: Analytics report refused — format {format} is not supported by this binary.
rubix.extension.install.succeeded: Extension {id} installed (at {at}); it will surface after the next agent boot.
rubix.extension.install.invalid_manifest: Extension install refused — the uploaded tarball does not contain a valid block.yaml manifest.
rubix.extension.uninstall.succeeded: Extension {id} uninstalled (at {at}); bundle directory removed and persistence row marked disabled.
rubix.extension.uninstall.not_found: Extension {id} cannot be uninstalled — no bundle directory exists for that id.

rubix.dashboard.create.duplicate_id: Dashboard {page_id} already exists — pick a different id.
